ground_rule: Every Y is computed by tools/research_station.py from tools/ground.py (the canonical heightmap, rounded) and the lake's level in data/landmarks.json (shrew_lake.water_body.level_y). Nothing in this file is a Y except where it is the lake's level, restated as a check. A building on land is seated on max(ground under it) + 1 (tools/lopunny_house.py's and tools/shrines.py's convention). A deck replaces the lake's top water layer, the sea town's rule (data/sea_town.json levels.deck) with the lake's level in place of the sea's: the deck block is at the level, the walk one above.

Decks are spruce planks on stripped spruce posts. None of these is in data/spawn_blocks.json (checked by the audit, C4). The town-ground tag the encounters design names (#cobblers:town_ground/<town>, docs/story/ENCOUNTERS.md) does not exist yet, so no roster is keyed to this paving: that is a second pass.

levels.for_the_owner: THE LEVEL-75 ROLL CAN NEVER BE CAUGHT. The catch block (data/level_cap.json) breaks free anything above the thrower's cap, and no cap in the campaign reaches 75: 55 after seven badges, 60 after eight (the Elite Four's aces, data/trainers.json elite_01..04), and the post-Champion cap is not known. The 50 and 55 rolls are catchable from seven badges. How often the 75 is rolled sits in bytecode logic and was NOT read. Mireille, the shrine's keeper, tells a player to let the old one go.

economy.switch: THE ONE SWITCH. economy.issuing in this file. false (today): the station's tick function (cobblers:research_station/tick, run every tick by #minecraft:tick) REMOVES the tags cobblers_station_issuing and cobblers_station_issuing_crown from every player, and the pack ships none of the earning advancements (the storm log, the ember survey, the lake trio, the courier's delivery). Every option that offers an item and every transition that gives one, in all four conversations, requires cobblers_station_issuing (the crown cobblers_station_issuing_crown); the transitions check it server-side, not only the option's visibility. So no item is given, and none can be earned. true: rebuild the pack (python tools/research_station.py build), install it, restart: the tick function ADDS cobblers_station_issuing to every player, the four earning advancements ship, and the options appear to players who meet each route's gate. The crown also needs post_champion_cap measured at 70 or more (Calyrex is a fixed level 70): until then cobblers_station_issuing_crown is never added, whatever issuing says. tools/research_station_audit.py checks both states.
